blocks.raw: The session logs feature enables you to track and review changes made for any customer by Intouch admin users. Session history displays the following information:
blocks.text: The session logs feature enables you to track and review changes made for any customer by Intouch admin users. Session history displays the following information:

blocks.raw:
* History of past sessions
* Reason for the changes made
* Date and time of each session by any user.
blocks.text: History of past sessionsReason for the changes madeDate and time of each session by any user.

blocks.raw: Session recording starts and logs the data automatically whenever you log into member care and access a customer profile. To end a session, perform the following:
blocks.text: Session recording starts and logs the data automatically whenever you log into member care and access a customer profile. To end a session, perform the following:

blocks.raw:
1. Click **End session**.\
   The **End session** dialogue box appears. This dialogue box also appears, if you try to navigate to the home page.
2. From the **Reason** drop-down, select the appropriate option. This field becomes optional if no changes are made.
3. (Optional) In the **Comments** text box, enter additional comments, if any.
4. Click **Yes, end session.**
